name: modus ponens
kb:
FACT f1: bird(tweety)
RULE r1: IF bird(X) THEN has_feathers(X) @1

name: transitivity depth 3
kb:
FACT a: is_a(a,b)
FACT b: is_a(b,c)
FACT c: is_a(c,d)
RULE t: IF is_a(X,Y) & is_a(Y,Z) THEN is_a(X,Z)

name: confidence multiplies
kb:
FACT f: p(x) @0.9
RULE r: IF p(X) THEN q(X) @0.8

name: confidence is the weakest premise
kb:
FACT f1: p(x) @0.6
FACT f2: s(x) @0.9
RULE r: IF p(X) & s(X) THEN q(X) @1

name: missing premise is UNKNOWN not false
kb:
FACT f: p(x)
RULE r: IF p(X) & s(X) THEN q(X)

name: unmet condition blocks rule and is reported
kb:
FACT f: water(s1)
RULE r: IF water(S) & COND std_pressure(S) THEN freezes(S)

name: condition met
kb:
FACT f: water(s1)
FACT g: std_pressure(s1)
RULE r: IF water(S) & COND std_pressure(S) THEN freezes(S)

name: absence of proof is not refutation
negation contradiction
kb:
FACT f: safe(x)
NOT g: safe(x)

name: functional contradiction
kb:
FUNC boiling_point/2
FACT a: boiling_point(w, 100)
FACT b: boiling_point(w, 90)

name: exclusive predicates contradict
kb:
EXCL solid/1 liquid/1
FACT a: solid(w)
FACT b: liquid(w)

name: assumption is not a premise
kb:
ASSUME a: p(x)
RULE r: IF p(X) THEN q(X)

name: negative premise needs explicit NOT
kb:
FACT f: bird(t)
RULE r: IF bird(X) & NOT penguin(X) THEN flies(X)

name: negative premise satisfied
kb:
FACT f: bird(t)
NOT n: penguin(t)
RULE r: IF bird(X) & NOT penguin(X) THEN flies(X)

name: rule head variable must be bound
kb: RULE r: IF p(X) THEN q(Y)
